text: Government AI systems should maintain meaningful human control. High-risk AI-influenced decisions should be subject to human validation. Teams should test systems before deployment and provide mechanisms for human intervention and user feedback.
Teams should manage the AI lifecycle, establish performance metrics, test systems under varied scenarios, including unusual cases, and use red teaming to identify weaknesses and unexpected behaviour.

Government organisations should consider transparency before deploying AI systems. AI projects should maintain documentation of data provenance, design decisions, assurance processes and evaluations to support accountability and auditing.
